alertmethod.description: Translation method for drop locations (e.g., 'kas' to use /proc/kallsyms)

alertlimit.description: Maximum number of alerts before stopping (0 = no limit)

alertmode.description: Alert mode: 'summary' for drop location stats, 'packet' for full packet data

trunc.description: Truncation length for packets (0 = no truncation; only effective in 'packet' alertmode)

queue.description: Kernel per-CPU queue length for packet alerts (default: 1000)

sw.description: Enable monitoring of software-originated drops (default: true)

hw.description: Enable monitoring of hardware-originated drops (default: false)
